## Print Strings and Variables

You can also display values and variables using a single print() function. For example:

```python
1name = "Jack"
2print("Name:", name)
```

Output

```text
Name: Jack
```

Here, the print() function displays the string "Name:" as it is, and displays the value stored in the variable name .

![The print() function treats string and variable as two separate parts because they are separated by a comma.](data:image/png;base64,)
